description: Panel listing pending editing suggestions, each showing its type, author, and preview text with accept and reject actions. Includes loading, empty, and status states.

parameters.name: CanReview
parameters.description: Whether the current user can accept or reject suggestions.

parameters.name: IsBusy
parameters.description: Whether a review action is running.

parameters.name: OnAcceptSuggestion
parameters.description: Raised when a suggestion should be accepted.

parameters.name: OnRejectSuggestion
parameters.description: Raised when a suggestion should be rejected.

parameters.name: OnSelectSuggestion
parameters.description: Raised when a suggestion is selected.
